channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Education Budget 2026: 8 Big Reforms Set to Transform Schools, Colleges and Careers
item.description: The Union Budget 2026 outlines eight major education reforms focusing on access, employability, innovation and inclusion.

item.title: UP Murder Unmasked: After Nine-Year Relationship, 2 Months of Marriage, Man Killed by Wife and In-Laws
item.description: A newly married man in Bareilly was allegedly murdered by his wife and in-laws, who then staged his death as suicide before police exposed the truth.

item.title: Deadliest Day in Pakistan’s Balochistan: 193 Killed in Coordinated Militant Assaults, Internet Cut Across Province
item.description: Coordinated attacks by Baloch militants across Pakistan’s Balochistan province killed civilians and security personnel, prompting a sweeping military crackdown and regional tensions.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Sports Ministry Allocation Rises to ₹4,479 Crore With New Khelo India Mission
item.description: India's 2026 budget boosts sports funding by eighteen percent and launches the new transformative Khelo India Mission.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: No Income Tax Slab Changes as Government Prioritizes New Simplified Tax Act
item.description: India's Union Budget 2026 retains existing tax slabs while simplifying compliance through the new Income Tax Act.

item.title: Devika Sihag Makes History at 20, Becomes Only Third Indian Woman to Win Super 300 Title
item.description: The Haryana shuttler dominated the Thailand Masters, defeating top seeds and claiming her maiden Super 300 title.

item.title: 4.7-Magnitude Earthquake Jolts Baramulla in Jammu and Kashmir; No Damage Reported
item.description: A moderate 4.7 magnitude earthquake struck Jammu and Kashmir before dawn, prompting brief panic but no reported damage or casualties.

item.title: Kerala Medical College Teachers Launch Indefinite OP Boycott Over Pay, Promotion Delays
item.description: Protesting unpaid arrears, staff shortages and safety concerns, Kerala’s government medical college teachers have launched an indefinite strike while continuing emergency services.

item.title: Union Budget 2026 Expands Lakhpati Didi Vision Through SHE-Marts for Women Entrepreneurs
item.description: The Union Budget 2026 scales up the Lakhpati Didi push by launching community-owned SHE-Marts for women.

item.title: Budget 2026: Key Announcements For Professionals, Startups and Investors You Can’t Ignore
item.description: Union Budget 2026 introduces the Income Tax Act 2025 and SME Growth Fund to empower India’s youth.
